name: respond-to-event
description: Responds to (RSVPs to) a Google Calendar invitation for the calendar's owner: accepts, declines or tentatively accepts it, with an optional comment, and tells the organizer unless sendUpdates says otherwise. Refuses an event the owner is not invited to. google-calendar__list-events supplies the eventId; calendarId defaults to "primary" and google-calendar__list-calendars supplies others.

eventId.description: The Google Calendar event ID supplied by list-events.

response.description: The response to send for the calendar owner's invitation.

comment.description: An optional comment to include with the response.

calendarId.description: Calendar ID supplied by list-calendars, or primary by default.

sendUpdates.description: Which guests Google Calendar should notify about the response.
